source_text.diagnosis: Q-1037 / GH #2364: main run 37696835452 (job 113050607649): all four partitions hit TEST_PARALLEL_PARTITION_TIMEOUT_S=1800 at 23:04:02 on a slow runner and the job log said nothing about where each partition was. Print per-partition and host diagnostics into the job log when the watchdog fires.

task.description:
In scripts/test_parallel.sh only, just BEFORE the watchdog's kill -TERM (the WARNING ... sending TERM to its process group site in the watchdog subshell), print per-partition DIAG lines prefixed 'test_parallel: DIAG partition N: ' (tail -n 40 of the partition log piped through cut -c1-300; 'approx tests finished' count from lines matching ^[.F*]+$ via one grep|tr -d '
'|wc -c; elapsed seconds from part_start_epoch and the timeout) and a once-per-run host block prefixed 'test_parallel: DIAG host: ' (uptime/loadavg, free -m, df -h /tmp ., ps top 8 by pcpu with a plain-ps fallback, nproc), guarded once via atomic mkdir "$tmp_dir/diag-host.lock". Every command guarded with || true and wrapped in 'timeout 5' when available. Existing WARNING text, exit codes and TERM/KILL logic unchanged; nothing printed on a normal run.
acceptance_criteria: Never cat the log; one grep pass; lines capped at 300 chars
host block exactly once even when several watchdogs fire together
bash -n passes; no other file changed besides scripts/test_parallel.sh

result.summary: Added test_parallel_diag_run and test_parallel_watchdog_diag to scripts/test_parallel.sh (defined before the launch loop); called from the watchdog subshell right after the unchanged WARNING and before kill -TERM. Per-partition DIAG lines (tail -n 40 capped at 300 cols, approx finished count via one grep, elapsed vs timeout) plus a once-per-run host block guarded by mkdir diag-host.lock in tmp_dir. All best-effort, timeout 5 when available, stderr. bash -n passes; throwaway harness confirmed output and single host block. Only scripts/test_parallel.sh changed.
